text:
anya (PM): Quick sync — customer X needs a path to onboard BYOK and also wants a 5-year evidence window for SOC2. how do we feel about the provisioning flow + an "escape hatch" to temporarily extend retention?

mike (security): We can support BYOK, but 5y evidence + BYOK increases our obligations: exportability, attestation, and key escrow/legal holds. need legal signoff. :warning:

sam (eng-infra): Technical caveats: long retention means larger cold-archive footprint. for BYOK we need per-tenant key metadata + rotation hooks. provisioning flow currently assumes default retention per-tenant (90d).

lee (ops): Ops question — if we offer a temporary retention extension (escape hatch), will that be self-service or support-only? self-service needs UI + billing changes. support-only is manual and slower but lower risk.

olivia (sales): Customer X will pay for premium if we do self-service. they want SLA that we can show in contract. they specifically asked: "can we flip retention to 5y for only audit logs and evidence exports?"

anya (PM): So open decisions: 1) escape hatch type (self-service vs support) 2) billing model for BYOK/onboarding (flat vs per-key vs per-GB ext.) 3) launch criteria (attestation, export, retention toggle, billing flows).

mike (security): Minimum launch gates: a) KMS attestation doc for customer, b) audit-proof export path (immutable snapshot + signed manifest), c) retention-change audit trail. Without these -> no BYOK in GA.

sam (eng-infra): Implementation notes: we can implement retention tiers: ephemeral (90d), extended (1y), archival (5y). API surface: PATCH /tenants/{id}/retention { "tier": "archival", "scope": ["audit_logs","evidence"] }

provision-bot: provisioning job queued: tenant X onboarding (BYOK) — job #8421. status: pending manual review.

lee (ops): Cost model suggestion: charge for archival storage monthly (per-GB) + per-tenant BYOK onboarding fee to cover escrow/logging compliance. we should model 3yr NPV to price right.

olivia (sales): customer's procurement insisted on keystore exclusivity during retention. they asked: does the keystore remain customer-owned during export runs?

mike (security): Yes, if BYOK we never import keys. we only store key metadata and call through KMS API for decryption. export involves a signed bundle that references key IDs; customer must sign/approve. need HSM attestation for certain banks.

anya (PM): Proposed MVP: - Support BYOK onboarding (manual kickoff) - Add retention tiers: 90d / 1y / 5y, toggle via support request - Provide evidence export with signed manifest - Billing: onboarding fee + per-GB/month archival charge - Launch gates: security attestation, legal signoff, ops runbook, cost estimate reviewed

sam (eng-infra): Risks: indexing/search on 5y archive will be slow/costly. recommend we keep archival as cold blob + limited query capability (export-only or sampled search).

lee (ops): Operational playbook needs an "escape hatch" definition: temporary retention flips require 2FA + SRE approval and auto-revert window. suggests: max 30-day manual extension window, after which billing automatically transitions to archival.

mike (security): Also require a retention-change CAP table and retention-change signed approval recorded in the audit log.

olivia (sales): For GA we need a clear product brief we can share with procurement teams (attestation list, export process, pricing). I'll draft once PM confirms MVP.

anya (PM): Action items: @sam prototype API + storage estimate (due EOW); @mike draft attestation checklist and export contract language (due Tue); @lee write ops runbook draft including escape hatch flow (due Wed); @olivia draft customer one-pager (due Thu).

sam (eng-infra): Ack, I'll include a sample cost calcs and a stubbed CLI call for manual export:
```bash
./redwood export evidence --tenant T123 --scope audit_logs --since 2020-01-01 --format tar.gz
```

lee (ops): Also adding playbook step: BEFORE export run, run `verify-keystore-ownership T123` and record screenshot/hash.

mike (security): Note: legal hold scenario — if legal hold is placed we must freeze deletion even if tenant toggles shorter retention. that's a separate flag in the model.

anya (PM): Good point. add legal_hold flag to data model and to MVP docs.

provision-bot: job #8421 manual review completed by lee — status: approved for staging.

olivia (sales): Customer X asked about pricing cap. can we offer a capped monthly archive spend for first 12 months?

lee (ops): We can, but it affects cost and must be codified in billing pipeline. ops needs a billing flag and quota enforcement.

anya (PM): OK — summary for roadmap: slot: Q2 pilot (manual onboarding + support-only retention toggle), Q3 GA (self-service retention toggle + billing integration) if gates met. I'll open a feature PR with the MVP spec.

mike (security): +1, but hold BYOK GA until attestation + legal are signed.

olivia (sales): I'll queue the pilot invite for Customer X.

anya (PM): Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with the PR and link to the runbook. :handshake:
